readings: For films whose running time (`film.length`) is at least 112 minutes, taken together as one group, what is the average running time, and what is the average of each film's replacement cost divided by its rental rate (`replacement_cost` / `rental_rate`, computed per film, then averaged)? Ignore missing values in each average (giving a missing value if none remain), return the two figures in that order as a single row, and don't round.
queries: SELECT AVG(length), AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) FROM film WHERE length >= 112;
